sm89.note: Ada. Two SMs per TPC (even/odd pair, SM 2k and 2k+1), one traversal unit per TPC (Throughput_8, Memory_5: measured on RTX 6000 Ada). Block placement with one block per SM: block b on SM 2b for b < SMs/2, then the odd SMs (measured on RTX 6000 Ada; re-measured per GPU by probe_placement.cu before any use).
